title: Align Kit Ports and Connectors in Ui and Engine
description: Separate Kit ports (Port entities) from type connectors in ComposeKit and MCP kitArtifacts; ensure naming matches Kit schema.
summary: Separated kit-level Port entities from type Connector rows in ComposeKit and MCP kitArtifacts: UI KitData now has ports + connectors, hierarchy uses kind port vs connector, selection adds connectorGuids. Engine _build_kit_artifact_data emits meta["ports"] from kit ports and meta["connectors"] from flattened type connectors with port ref normalization. Extended engine and UI tests. mcpEffectiveSurface now honors surface design/scene when mode is show-diagram (fixes unit test).
